info.title: Squire Local API
info.description: The LAN HTTP wire contract for the Squire household reward system — emitted from the Rust types (ADR SQUIRE-A-0009). IDs are int64 on the wire (a 'fits in i64' invariant).

post.summary:
`POST /admin/mark-done` — the Knight marks a quest done *for* a Squire: submit the claim
(`by = None`, child submission) then immediately approve it (acting Knight). Two commands
through the shared writer. The `claim_id` is Knight-minted so a retried outbox is idempotent:
the submit replay no-ops, and a re-approve of the now-resolved claim is `AlreadyReviewed` →
409 (a genuine second mark-done), which is correct.

post.summary:
`POST /admin/members/{id}/active` (RequireKnight) — de/reactivate a member via `SetUserActive`
(archive-not-delete), audited to the acting Knight. A missing member is a 404; a Knight cannot
deactivate **their own** account (no self-lockout) → 400.

post.summary:
`POST /admin/redeem` — a direct Knight redeem for `squire`. `by = None` (an activity event,
not authoring). Idempotent on `command_id`: an empty-changeset replay is treated as success.

post.summary:
`POST /admin/review-claim` — approve / reject a Squire's pending completion claim. The acting
Knight is the token's user. A second review of an already-resolved claim is `AlreadyReviewed`
→ 409.

`POST /admin/review-redemption` — approve (→ `ItemRedeemed`) / reject a Squire's redemption
request. A second review is `AlreadyReviewed` → 409.

409.description: Request already reviewed, or blocked at commit

get.summary:
`GET /admin/squire/{id}/state` — the **"assume Squire"** read (SQUIRE-T-0053): a Knight fetches
any Squire's full [`StateView`] (the same assembly `GET /state` gives that Squire), so the parent
can view + operate a child's home. Read-only — acting still goes through the Knight's privileged
commands (mark-done / redeem / adjust), so the audit/single-writer model is untouched. An id that
isn't an active Squire is a 404.

parameters.description: The Squire's user id

post.summary:
`POST /claims` (RequireSquire) — submit a completion claim for the authenticated Squire.
Idempotent on the phone-minted `claim_id` (a replay returns the current state). Returns the
resulting [`ClaimState`] (`Pending`, or `Approved { points }` if the quest auto-approves).

parameters.description: Opaque household handle routing the request to its tenant

403.description: Authenticated but not a Squire, or not allowed to act on this occurrence

get.summary:
`GET /household-review` — the Knight's cross-Squire triage view, assembled from one snapshot:
every active Squire with a clamped balance, plus the household-wide pending claims and pending
redemption requests (each labelled with its Squire and the quest/item name).

post.summary:
`POST /login` (unauthenticated) — exchange a member secret for a tenant-scoped token. A bad
secret (or unknown member) is a 401.

200.description: A tenant-scoped token and the member's role

post.summary:
`POST /members` ([`RequireKnight`]) — add a member (Knight or Squire). The acting caller comes
from the verified token; a Squire token never reaches here (the extractor 403s it).

parameters.name: X-Household
parameters.description: Opaque household handle routing the request to its tenant

post.summary:
`POST /pair` (**unauthenticated**) — a phone exchanges a one-time pairing code for the member's
tenant-scoped token (ADR SQUIRE-A-0010). An unknown / expired / already-used code is a uniform
401 (no enumeration oracle). `household` routes to the tenant (carried from the QR).

200.description: The paired member's token and identity

401.description: Unknown, expired, or already-used pairing code

post.summary:
`POST /pair/codes` ([`RequireKnight`]) — mint a one-time device-pairing code for a member
(ADR SQUIRE-A-0010). The Keep renders the returned code as a QR; a Squire token is 403'd at the
extractor.

parameters.name: X-Household
parameters.description: Opaque household handle routing the request to its tenant

200.description: The minted pairing code and its expiry

403.description: Authenticated but not a Knight, or unknown/inactive target member

post.summary:
`POST /redemption-requests` (RequireSquire) — record a redemption request for the
authenticated Squire. No affordability check (it is re-checked at approval time). Idempotent
on the phone-minted `request_id`; always reports `Pending` (a fresh request is never resolved
in the same call, and an idempotent replay returns the still-pending request).

parameters.name: X-Household
parameters.description: Opaque household handle routing the request to its tenant

post.summary:
`POST /register` (unauthenticated) — create a household + seed its first Knight, returning the
new handle, the admin's [`UserId`](domain_core::contract::UserId), and the admin's token.

200.description: Household created; returns the handle, admin id, and admin token

get.summary:
`GET /state` (RequireSquire) — assemble the authenticated Squire's full [`StateView`] from a
single snapshot. Returns 200 JSON; the Squire is always `principal.user` (token-derived).

parameters.name: X-Household
parameters.description: Opaque household handle routing the request to its tenant

200.description: The authenticated Squire's full state view

AchCriterionKind.description: Achievement criterion kind on the wire (flat).

AchScopeKind.description: Achievement scope kind on the wire (flat).

AchievementSummaryDto.description: An achievement in the authoring list — flat, with a server-computed summary.

summary.description: e.g. "7-day streak · Bedroom", "20 completions · Kitchen", "100 points".

Ack.description: The small JSON ack every quick-action returns on success.

AddMemberReq.description: Knight-only — add a member (Knight or Squire). No assumed counts or family shape.

AdjustReq.description: `POST /admin/adjust` body — a Knight balance override on `squire`. Deduped on `command_id`.

AuthToken.description: A tenant-scoped bearer token proving (household, user, role). Presented on every call.

AvailabilityKind.description:
Reward availability on the wire (flat): `Repeatable` (a recurring privilege) or `Once` (a one-time
treat, out of stock household-wide after the first redemption).

BadgeView.description:
An achievement the Squire has already **earned** (an `AchievementUnlocked` event exists), shown
as a badge on the child home (SQUIRE-T-0079) — distinct from a [`StreakView`] (still in progress).

at.description: When it was earned (newest first in the list).

bonus.description: The bonus points this unlock awarded.

CadenceKind.description:
Quest cadence on the wire (flat). `weekdays` applies to `Weekly`; `due` (a `Date` day-count) to
`OneOff`; `Daily` uses neither.

Category.description: Free-form text labels — the parent types whatever grouping they like.

oneOf.description: Present (and required) for [`ClaimStateKind::Approved`]: the points awarded.

CommandId.description:
Client-minted idempotency key for privileged commands that lack a natural one
(`RedeemItem` direct, `AdjustPoints`). The parent phone's offline outbox mints it
once and reuses it on every retry; the engine dedupes by finding an emitted event
that already carries it, so retry-safety stays *derived from the append-only log*
— the same mechanism as `claim_id` / `request_id`. See ADR SQUIRE-A-0001.

CompletionDto.description: How an assigned occurrence is satisfied, on the wire.

CreateAchievementReq.description: `POST /admin/achievements` request — a flat achievement definition authored from the phone.

bonus.description: Bonus points awarded (may be 0 for a pure unlock).

oneOf.description: Existing id to edit (upsert), or null/absent to create (the server assigns).

scope_category.description: Category label when `scope = Category` (must be non-blank).

CreateItemReq.description: `POST /admin/items` request — a flat reward definition authored from the phone.

cost.description: Cost in points (clamped ≥ 0; the phone form enforces ≥ 1).

description.description: Optional flavor text shown to the child.

oneOf.description: Optional achievement that must be unlocked before this reward can be redeemed.
Existing id to edit (upsert), or null/absent to create (the server assigns).

CreateQuestReq.description: `POST /admin/quests` request — a flat quest definition authored from the parent phone.

assign_all.description: True = all squires (auto-includes ones added later); false = the explicit `squires` list.

oneOf.description: Optional due date (a `Date` day-count) for a `OneOff` cadence.
Existing quest id to edit (upsert), or null/absent to create a new one (the server assigns).

squires.description: Explicit assignees when `assign_all` is false (≥1 active Squire required). `null`/absent ⇒ none.

weekdays.description: Days for a `Weekly` cadence (≥1 required for `Weekly`). `null`/absent ⇒ none.

CreatedAchievement.description: The id of a created / edited achievement, echoed back.

CreatedItem.description: The id of a created / edited reward, echoed back.

CreatedQuest.description: The id of a created / edited quest, echoed back.

DecisionDto.description:
A review decision as it arrives on the wire. **Flat struct** (not an externally-tagged enum):
`{"verdict":"approve"}` or `{"verdict":"reject","reason":"…"}`. The tagged-enum form made
openapi-generator emit an undecodable Kotlin class (it couldn't represent the bare `Approve`),
so — exactly like the T-0033 state enums — we discriminate on a `verdict` field plus an optional
payload. Maps onto the domain [`Decision`].

reason.description: Optional note for a [`DecisionKind::Reject`]; omitted on the wire when absent.

DecisionKind.description: The two review verdicts, as a flat string discriminant on the wire.

GoalView.description:
An achievement the Squire has **not yet earned**, shown as a "goal to unlock" on the child home
(SQUIRE-T-0094 #3) — so every available achievement, not only streaks, is visible to work toward.

bonus.description: The bonus coins awarded when it unlocks.

description.description: How to earn it, in kid-friendly words — e.g. "Complete 10 chores" or "Earn 100 coins".

HouseholdHandle.description:
Opaque handle a paired device presents to route to its household (and, hosted, to
select the schema — ADR SQUIRE-A-0002). Established at registration/pairing.

HouseholdReview.description:
Parent (Knight) review read — pending work across ALL Squires, each labeled with its
Squire, plus per-Squire balances. The Knight renders/triages this; the exact shape is
still an open decision in SQUIRE-S-0003 / S-0006.

items.description: Active redeemable items the Knight can direct-redeem on a Squire's behalf (REQ-K5).

quests.description: Active quests the Knight can mark done for a Squire (REQ-K3), paired with [`today`].

today.description: The server's "today" (date number) — the `on` a mark-done claim is filed against.

ItemOption.description:
A redeemable item the Knight can pick for a direct redeem (REQ-K5). Affordability/availability
are re-checked by the Keep at commit, so this is just the catalog, not a per-Squire eligibility.

ItemSummaryDto.description: A reward in the authoring list — flat, with a server-computed availability/gate summary.

LoginReq.description: POST /login (or device pair) — exchange a member secret for a tenant-scoped token.

MarkDoneReq.description:
`POST /admin/mark-done` body — submit-then-approve a claim for `squire` in one shot. The
`claim_id` is Knight-minted for idempotency.

MemberSummaryDto.description: A household member in the authoring list — flat (id as an i64 wire number, role as a plain string).

MintPairCodeReq.description:
POST /pair/codes (Knight-only) — mint a one-time device-pairing code for member `user`
(ADR SQUIRE-A-0010). The plaintext `code` is returned once for the Keep to render as a QR.

MintPairCodeResp.description: The minted pairing code and its expiry (unix millis). Single-use; ≥128-bit; 30-min TTL.

PairReq.description:
POST /pair (unauthenticated) — a phone exchanges a one-time pairing code for the member's
tenant-scoped token (ADR SQUIRE-A-0010). `household` routes to the tenant (from the QR).

PairResp.description: The paired member's tenant-scoped token + identity (same token shape as `/login`, A-0004).

QuestOption.description: An active quest the Knight can pick for a mark-done (REQ-K3).

QuestSummaryDto.description:
A quest in the authoring list — flat, with cadence/assignment **labels computed server-side**
(so the phone list needs no enum decoding).

RedeemReq.description:
`POST /admin/redeem` body — a direct Knight redeem on a target `squire`. Deduped on
`command_id`.

RegisterHouseholdReq.description:
POST /register — create a Household (tenant) + seed its first Knight (admin); provisions
an isolated schema. Returns the handle and the admin's token.

RequestRedemptionReq.description:
POST /redemption-requests — idempotent on `request_id` (phone-minted), same as claims.
Affordability is re-checked at approval time, so a request can be made even if the
balance is borderline; the parent sees whether it still clears when they review.

ReviewClaimReq.description: `POST /admin/review-claim` body. `actor` is the acting Knight, filled from the token.

StateView.description:
GET /state — everything a Squire's phone renders, fully cacheable for offline use.
Scoped to one Squire (`squire`); the Knight's review queue is a separate parent read
(`HouseholdReview`).

badges.description:
Achievements the Squire has already earned (SQUIRE-T-0079). `#[serde(default)]` so a payload
from an older server without the field still deserializes.

goals.description:
Achievements not yet earned — "goals to unlock" on the child home (SQUIRE-T-0094 #3), so every
available achievement (not only the in-progress streaks) is visible to work toward.
`#[serde(default)]` so an older server's payload still deserializes.

SubmitClaimReq.description:
POST /claims — idempotent on `claim_id` (the phone mints it), so the offline
outbox can retry safely. Returns Pending, or Approved if the quest auto-approves.

UserId.description:
Identifies a household member. A household has one-or-more Knights (adult/parent) and
Squires (child/player) — counts are fixed nowhere. Player activity is attributed to a
Squire via this id. See ADR SQUIRE-A-0004. (Tenancy is schema-level and absent from
these types — ADR SQUIRE-A-0002.)

WeekdayDto.description: A weekday on the wire (mirrors the domain `Weekday`, flat string enum).

bearer_auth.description: Tenant-scoped bearer token (proves household, user, role).
